info.title: ky-ai-ng — run the Angular CLI with output mirrored for agents.
info.description: Angular CLI dev-loop runner for AI agents: runs ng serve/build with build state and logs exposed over MCP.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: SERVE — a frontend's dev server (run one per app; registers with the hub for the agent):

options.name: --name
options.description: Project name in the hub (default: parent folder of ClientApp)

options.name: --log-lines
options.description: Lines kept in the in-memory log buffer (default: 200; 0 = unlimited)

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Also mirror the buffer to a file (default: off — MCP serves logs)

options.name: --hub-port
options.description: Hub port to register with (default: 5101; rarely needed — does not start a hub)

options.name: --no-hub
options.description:
Standalone: buffer + local REST only; no hub, no agent access
Anything else after `serve` is forwarded to `ng serve` (e.g. --port 4015).
Stopping (Ctrl+C or a hard kill) reaps the whole ng tree and deregisters from the hub.
